And the indeclinable word अस्तम् 'at home' is called गति , when in composition with a verb.

Terms: गति-पुरः

भू is the substitute of the verb अस् 'to be' when an आर्धधातुक affix is to be applied.

Terms: आर्धधातुक-substitutes

The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'this is whose belief' after the words 1. अस्ति 2. नास्ति and 3. दिष्ट।

Terms: ठक्

The same substitution takes place when the affix अस्ताति follows.

Terms: अस्ताति

A single consonantal सार्वधातुक affix gets the augment ईट् after अस् (अस्ति) and after the Aorist character सिच् ।

Terms: ईट् augment
